set: B v6: the 223 v5 anatomies with every TopBrain piece posed anatomically (forks, siphons, VA tops), the donor vertebral artery's own subclavian junction and distal subclavian, the donor-wall bone-side fix, w_018b_left mr_002's VA moved, and a build record generated from the final state

derived_from.per_anatomy: carotid_data/anatomies_v6/<name>/provenance.json (+ mesh_v6.json, LICENSE_*.txt) -- the final state; no assignment-time, dry-run or collection copies
derived_from.verified_by: _records/checks/build_record_check.json (check_build_record.py: every count recounted from provenance with separate code; also compared with the build collection results/v6_build.json)

provenance_digest.rule: sha256 over the lines '<name> <sha256 of provenance.json>\n', sorted by name

what_v6_changes: TopBrain piece orientation (audit 'TopBrain piece orientation audit (v5)'): every piece posed anatomically with superior and heading pinned and a bounded, blended seam bend; orientation gates in code (orient_gates.py)
right forks (the RCCA training route) re-posed to their per-patient Zenodo map (D19); forks from the patient's other side x-mirrored (D20); the RCCA prefix (arch -> seam 1) stays host, bit-identical
left forks: own fork, else a split-keeping substitute (D1), re-posed by the Zenodo map (D11); never the host LCCA tube
VA tops posed anatomically toward the basilar target and stopped >= 0.6 mm apart (D2); ECA tips skipped on down-pointing ECAs (D4)
donor VAs keep the donor's own subclavian -> VA junction (item e) and the donor's own distal subclavian to a cut end (D17); pinched ostia tube-bridged (D16); sides that fail keep v5's junction (D18)
donor wall bone-side fix only in the artefact zones (D15, plateau rule), v5's coarse surface elsewhere
w_018b_left mr_002: VA moved with the route13 tool (item b)
one bake (bake_v6 1.1 = v5's handle rule + E1-E7, C4, D20) and one frozen toolchain; checks_v6 (D22 / D26 / D27)

s3_fix (final verifier's must-fix list, D27): 8 right-route pieces that lost real scanned wall against v4's / v5's shipped wall re-baked with bake_v6 1.2 (L1 lattice shift on 4, L2 route-island bridge on 4); 8 pieces with a 0.1-1 % deficit accepted and flagged (record only); one fold-over pair removed from m_022_left mr_021_L's OBJ; checks_v6 1.6 adds the coverage gate (against the v4 / v5 shipped wall) and the OBJ fold-over gate

s4_records (the second final verifier's must-fix, D27, record only): the 10 pieces with a real-wall deficit > 0 and < 0.1 % flagged in provenance (v6_checks.flags d27_coverage_*, v6_checks.s4_records), so all 18 pieces with a measurable deficit carry a flag; no geometry change

decisions.by: orchestrator; rule approved and amended by the user 2026-10-03 18:20 / 18:30 / 18:35
decisions.text: left forks: own fork if its siphon passes; else the ladder (re-pose; same-group substitute; any split-keeping substitute; ICA extension <= 10 mm / anchor trim; last resort a longer ICA extension, then the full bend allowance); never the host LCCA tube
VA tops anatomical, aimed at the basilar target, >= 0.6 mm apart, no basilar fusion
anatomical heading (A0) + bounded seam bend <= 45 deg, blended; D3-fork: forks by the per-patient Zenodo map
skip the ECA tip extension on down-pointing ECAs
walls stay coarse (real, irregular, non-tube)
anchor_low blocking on the LICA seam and ECA tips, informational on the RICA
ICA-termini spacing gate two-sided (within 20 mm of native)
va_target <= 20 mm passes; 20-30 mm accepted + flag; > 30 mm -> D9
VA ladder: donor junction + anatomical top -> v5 junction + anatomical top -> v5's top as shipped (flag); never drop a donor VA; course RMS <= 20 mm on the donor stretch
VA corridor gate over z 440-540: lateral offset within +-8 mm of the donor's native offset (fallback: <= 8 mm medial of the host VA)
left forks re-posed by the per-patient Zenodo map where bend <= 45 and all gates pass, else v5's pose (flag); ICA-terminus AP offset recorded, flagged > 40 mm
ica_spacing like for like (back-mapped piece ends)
right-route baseline = v4 without its RECA tip where v4's tip ran along the ICA and v6 re-poses / skips it
SOFA VA entry: >= 3 seeds + a geometric entry test, reported against v5, not a gate
donor wall: plateau fix only in the artefact zones (bone contact / floored + short blend), v5's coarse surface elsewhere
pinched donor VA ostia (ia172_164 L, ia172_071 L) bridged with a short tube at VA calibre; flag the tubed mm
the donor's own distal subclavian continues to the end of its segmentation as a cut end (tube to ~30 mm past the ostium if short, flagged); the host distal subclavian is dropped on those sides
sides still failing after D16 / D17 keep v5's junction (flag); no other relaxations
right forks re-posed to their anatomical heading; seam-1 bend <= 45 blended, host-cut search, then up to 60 blended (flag); the RCCA prefix stays host
forks from the patient's other side x-mirrored before placement (winding flipped, chirality recorded)
the 17 VA sides with no donor since v5 are not in this build

right-route check for moved pieces = surface preserved: >= 99 % of the piece's real surface beyond the blend within 0.3 mm of v4's surface carried by the piece's own transform; blend zones and handle windows reported, not gated; RCCA prefix bit-identical
w_017_left mr_002_L right VA on D9 rung 3 (tier A): keep the donor VA, accept + flag
right forks on R4 / R5 accepted with flags, re-evaluated under D22
D17 direction gate; 1 mm joins at every sampling phase; records fixed; one frozen toolchain (md5 manifest)
where v4's mesh hid part of a moved piece's own scanned surface, D22 compares with the piece's own scanned surface; flagged d22_reference = own_surface

decisions.by: user 2026-10-07 16:25 (rule); checks_v6 1.5 is the build agent's implementation
decisions.text: no stopping for choices: residuals get the recommended minimal option + a flag; k_011_left mr_012_L's siphon deficit on the bake's repair capsule = a bake repair window, reported not gated. Applied by s3_fix (2026-10-08) to the final verifier's coverage finding: a real-wall deficit >= 1 % of a piece takes a fix that restores the wall (a targeted re-bake: bake_v6 1.2 lattice shift L1, else route-island bridge L2), else v5's geometry for that piece; < 1 % is accepted with a flag
